title: Bacterial and archaeal cell division: diverse mechanisms and models

about: EMBO Workshop "Bacterial and archaeal cell division: diverse mechanisms and models" will take place in Barga, Italy, from 20 to 23 April 2027. Registration closes on 6 January 2027. Abstracts are also due on 6 January 2027.
